title: Tip deflection of the reference cantilever at element degree 2
objective: Verify that the 3D linear-elastic solve reproduces the Euler-Bernoulli tip deflection of the reference steel cantilever within the validated band at the validated element degree.

qoi.name: tip displacement
qoi.definition: the maximum |u_z| over the displacement dofs — the tip deflection of the transversely loaded cantilever
qoi.how_extracted: returned by the wrapper on every valid run; the requested number per the contract's quantity key

success_criterion.statement: The coarse-mesh tip deflection exceeds 0.0029 m (within ~5% of the Euler-Bernoulli value 0.0030476 m, approaching from below).

regime.notes: Slender reference beam (L/h = 20 >= 10, G1), small deflection (delta/L ~ 0.3% <= 10%, G2), element_degree 2 at the validated floor (G5); the requested QoI is the validated tip_displacement, not the reported-only stress.

mini_experiment.expected_observation: tip_displacement 0.003008 -> 0.003029 m across mesh 8 -> 16, converging toward the Euler-Bernoulli 0.0030476 m from below.

full_experiment.design: The three-rung refinement ladder (mesh 8/16/32) at degree 2, comparing each tip deflection to the closed form; degree 3 on the coarsest rung as an over-resolution check.
